name: Priestess Anetta
summary: Within Northshire Abbey, Priestess Anetta teaches new priests the first rites of the Holy Light. A human cleric, she belongs to the Brotherhood of Northshire.

sections.title: Tender of the Faithful
sections.body: Priestess Anetta keeps to the quiet library wing on Northshire Abbey’s ground floor. Defias bandits and kobolds trouble the valley. She reminds those who pass that the Light may be the one thing that saves them someday.

sections.title: Guiding Novice Priests
sections.body: New human priests come to Priestess Anetta in the cloister with a hallowed letter of introduction. She teaches them holy words to mend flesh and call down smiting radiance against evil. Under her guidance, the young acolytes prepare to carry the Light beyond Northshire’s secluded walls.

faq.answer: Priestess Anetta is a human cleric of the Holy Light and a member of the Brotherhood of Northshire. On Northshire Abbey’s ground floor, she mentors newly arrived priests in their first sacred rites.

faq.q: Where can I find Priestess Anetta?
faq.answer: Priestess Anetta is inside Northshire Abbey in northern Elwynn Forest. Enter the front gates and go into the main hall. Look for her on the ground floor of the library wing.

faq.q: What role does she play in the Abbey's defense?
faq.answer: Stormwind marshals and recruits fight to reclaim the valley from Defias bandits and kobolds. Priestess Anetta trains priests to heal and protect their comrades with the Light.
Priestess Anetta teaches young priests entry-level prayers and clerical spells. They learn to heal and smite enemies in the name of the Holy Light.

angles.text: As a young human priest beginning in Northshire, you meet Priestess Anetta as your first mentor. She affirms your holy calling and teaches you to commune directly with the Light.
Priestess Anetta prepares young priests to support those defending Northshire Valley.
